sampling_policy: Unmodified m2_forcing analytic primitive of each original piecewise-linear interval; linspace endpoint alignment; one braking segment only

single_segment_adapter.method: Call original m2_forcing with cycles=0 and the sole terminal block carrying P1-A brake samples at unit time scale; relabel that block as single_brake, not final_cool

thresholds_registered_before_execution.basis: m2_forcing: source heat residual <1e-6 J, partition <1e-7 W, maximum-step allowance 1e-10 s; M2 YAML energy relative tolerance 1e-6. Independent interval comparison uses partition tolerance; network tolerances are serialization checks, not physical calibration.

omission_policy: P1-A inactive motor and zero-transmitted-power gearbox budgets omit unknown drag, standby and churning; zero budget is not measured zero loss.
topology_limit: The immutable M2 13-node network includes an active shield node. This input adaptation is not proof of an unshielded Case0 network. Any topology change needs separate authorization.
